properties.name: West Bluebonnet Trail
properties.note: Roads sourced from the official 2018 Ennis Bluebonnet Trails & Festival map (Ennis Garden Club, mirrored via travellatte.net; bluebonnettrail.org/trailmap and visitennistexas.com had no turn-by-turn text). Waypoint order along the West Trail (green on the source map) was interpreted from the map graphic — FM 1722, Baldridge St/Kachina Prairie, Bluebonnet Park, Lakeview Dr near Lake Bardwell, and the Meadow View Nature Area vicinity — then connected with real roads via OSRM. Exact turn sequence may not perfectly match the current official trail; confirm with a current-year map at the Welcome Center.

properties.name: Slingshot Scenic Loop
properties.note: Curated scenic suggestion, not an official Bluebonnet Trail. Built for the Ennis Slingshot site: starts/ends at the Ennis Welcome Center and routes via OSRM through Sugar Ridge Rd/Sugar Ridge Winery near Bristol, the Lakeview Dr/Lake Bardwell area, and the Meadow View Nature Area vicinity. Distance and duration are OSRM's real driving estimate, not a guaranteed ~2 hour target.

properties.name: Ennis Welcome Center
properties.description: Starting point for the Ennis Bluebonnet Trails; bluebonnet trail maps and current bloom status are available here during the April trail season.

properties.name: Meadow View Nature Area
properties.description: 39-acre nature area near Bardwell Lake on the West Bluebonnet Trail; per the official trail map, access is via Hwy 34 only, and it is best known as an April bluebonnet photo location. Coordinate is a road-proxy (Laneview Dr) since the nature area itself is not indexed by name in OpenStreetMap/Nominatim.
properties.source: Nominatim geocoding (Laneview Dr proxy); official 2018 Ennis Bluebonnet Trails map

properties.name: Bluebonnet Park
properties.description: 47-acre city park at 201 S Highway 287 in Ennis, marked as a trail landmark on the official Bluebonnet Trails map.

properties.name: Sugar Ridge Winery
properties.description: Winery at 353 Sugar Ridge Rd near Bristol, TX, marked with a winery icon on the official North Bluebonnet Trail map. The exact street address did not resolve in Nominatim, so this coordinate is the Sugar Ridge Rd centroid near Bristol shown on the source map.
properties.source: Nominatim geocoding (Sugar Ridge Rd centroid, address unresolved); official 2018 Ennis Bluebonnet Trails map

properties.name: Lakeview Drive / Lake Bardwell Area
properties.description: Lakeview Drive along Bardwell Lake, on the West Bluebonnet Trail; a popular scenic and photo area southwest of downtown Ennis.

properties.name: Downtown Ennis Parking
properties.description: General parking area in downtown Ennis near W Knox St and the historic downtown square, a reasonable staging point close to the Welcome Center for trail visitors.
